text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The long-awaited Arima Kinen is here. Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond's dream of racing together in a G1 race is on the cusp of becoming reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black promises to lead Satono Diamond across the finish line, while the latter promises to finish one step ahead of her. Finally, their dream race is about to begin!
